value.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for multi-dimensional configuration grids, verified cell lifecycles, boundary auto-expansion and zero-magic-literal AST gates
value.lets_workers: Replace hardcoded magic constants with externalized multi-dimensional NodeGrid specifications, clamp runtime inputs with ParameterBounds, advance cells through GridLedger only after independent verification, resolve optimal cells per workload regime via OperationCostLedger, expand saturated range endpoints into a new grid generation and enforce zero hardcoded numbers mechanically with ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate.

flow.when: Declare tunable choice, integer_range, float_range and boolean axes with cross-parameter constraints, clamp runtime inputs and enumerate applicable cells.
Scan operational Python functions and classes via AST to reject inline numeric magic literals beyond canonical mathematical identities.
Independently verify evaluated cell metrics, promote the cell for its workload regime and auto-expand saturated grid boundaries into generation+1.

value.worked_example: Made-up 4-axis context-shim and retrieval tuning grid recomputed in test_config_grids.py: enumerates 72 represented cells and 48 applicable cells under the deletes-require-cuckoo constraint, blocks proposer self-verification (409), promotes a distinct-verifier cell, resolves verified_ledger_optimum for mutable_spider_frontier, expands saturated shim_max_chars (2400->4800) and probe_radius_bits (2->4) into generation 2, passes clean AST code and flags inline magic literal 1800.

value.title: Guardrail: configuration cells cannot skip lifecycle states or promote without a distinct verifier
value.category_reason: Prevents unverified tuning cells or single-worker self-approvals from entering regime selection.
value.rule: Every cell progresses sequentially through represented -> applicable -> proposed -> dispatched -> evaluated -> verified -> promoted, and transitioning to verified requires worker_id and key_id distinct from the proposer.
value.how_it_is_checked: GridLedger.transition returns status_code 409 on lifecycle skips, constraint-violating cells or matching proposer/verifier identities.

value.category_reason: Forces behavioral thresholds, capacities, timeouts and budgets into externalized configuration grids.
